title: Digniin Yar Ka Horreysa Marti-geliye Socod
intro: U gudub dooxo ay ku soo socdaan taliye xooggan iyo ciidan badan, oo sawir qof yar oo socdaal ah oo bixinaya digniin badbaadisa bulsho dhan. Marka bulshada halista ku jirta ay gaarto hoy, khatartu way dhaaftaa. Raac tilmaamaha si aad u aqoonsato qofka la iska indho tiray ee ka dambeeya digniintaas.
clues: Waxaan ka mid ahay xayawaannada yaryar ee lala xiriiriyo boqortooyada taliyaha.
Bulshadeydu waxay ku nooshahay guryo ku yaal dooxo, halkaas oo midkeen uu kuwa kale ugu yeeri karo.
Waxaan la kulannaa hanjabaad ka timid taliyahaas iyo ciidamada la socda taliyaha.
Aniga ayaa ah kan ugu yeeraya bulshadayda inay guryahooda galaan oo naga diga inaan la burburin si aan la garanayn.
Taliyuhu waa Sulaymaan, noocayguna wuxuu ka mid yahay makhluuqaadka la hoos geeyay.
Waxaan ahay qudhaanjada dooxadaas; ka dib digniintaydii, waxaan galnay guryaheenna oo waxaan ka baxnay burburkii haddii kale na qabsan lahaa anigoo aan ogayn.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Codsi faraanti ah oo ka yimid kalluun
Diidmo ah in la cuno cuntada taliyaha

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Bulshada ayaa ka badbaaday ka dib markii ay hoydeen
Bulshada waa la burburiyay iyadoon gabbaad qaadan
Bulshada waa la badbaadiyay sababtoo ah ciidanku way dib u gurteen
Bulshada waxaa lagu abaalmariyay inay xakamayso shimbiraha.
Bulshada waxaa loo kaxaystay maxkamadda boqortooyada
outcome.answer: Bulshada ayaa ka badbaaday ka dib markii ay hoydeen

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
